Marker_PlacementCursor.channels: quad = 1.5 cells (cell edge at 0.96 cell, as MarkerCellFraction). R edge line, brightest in the corners; G inner fill (stronger near the edge); B soft halo outside the cell; A max

Marker_FreeCell.channels: one cell. R soft rounded glow (no hard frame), G a very faint inner rim; fade per cell by distance to the cursor (only while placing)

Marker_PlacementCursor.note: 1.5 x 1.5 at cell size 1; scale by CellSize
